title: Empty ImmutableMultiDict returned
detail: If `cookie` is not empty, an empty `ImmutableMultiDict` is returned instead of parsing the cookie string.
note: Describes the planted negation: a non-empty cookie returns an empty dict.

title: Incorrect argument passing
note: A string is what parse_cookie takes now.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` from `http` module does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when calling `parse_cookie` with additional keyword arguments.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `combined_cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` from `http` module does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when calling `parse_cookie` with additional keyword arguments.

title: Incorrect modification of host
detail: The host is modified by removing the leading dot, which can lead to incorrect domain boundary checks.
note: Near the bug, but about stripping the leading dot, which the PR does on purpose.

title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition checks if the hostname is not equal to the host or if the host_with_port is equal to the host. This logic is incorrect and should be revised to properly handle domain boundaries.
note: Describes the planted flip in the no_proxy match.

title: Duplicate event
detail: The `send_size_event()` is called twice, which might lead to duplicate resize events being processed.
note: One call is in the resize handler, the other runs once at start.

title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition checks if both horizontal and vertical breakpoints exist, but the original code handled them separately. This change might lead to missing breakpoint updates if only one type of breakpoint exists.
note: Describes the planted `and`: one kind of breakpoint alone no longer updates.

title: File handle not closed
detail: The file handle `fin` is opened but not closed in the `encode` method, leading to a resource leak.
note: The stream closes this file at the end; in the planted version that close is never awaited, so it does stay open, but the finding doesn't say why or where.

title: File handle not closed
detail: The file handle `fin` is opened but not closed in the `encode` method, leading to a resource leak.
note: In the sync version the stream closes the file at the end.

title: Wider exception handling
detail: Catching OSError instead of PermissionError may mask other issues like FileNotFoundError or NotADirectoryError. The same applies to line 508.
note: Catching OSError is the PR's deliberate fix.
